other_conditions: Applicant must be registered for PhD research at a recognized university in India after an interview with the Research Degree Committee.
Applicant must have obtained the minimum qualifying marks in the postgraduate degree as prescribed for SC/ST students by UGC guidelines.
Scholarship is payable for a maximum period of three years, subject to continued eligibility.
A yearly quota of 100 scholarships for Scheduled Castes and 56 scholarships for Scheduled Tribes is fixed.
benefits_summary: Recipients receive ₹16,000 per month (₹1,92,000 per year) for up to three years.
